-- lisp/lisp.lgo --
(package lisp)

(func greet [-name string] [string]
  (return (+ "hello, " -name)))
-- mixed/mixed.lgo --
(package mixed)

(import "example.com/golisp/lisp")

(func message [] [string]
  (return (lisp.greet (who))))
-- mixed/who.go --
package mixed

func Who() string { return "module cache" }
